title: Identification of localized smooth coefficient comparisons and their equations
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum $p,a,q,k_0,k,\ell,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of [def-pur-conventions], and let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For each finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in the fixed closure use the integral finite-Tor categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and their raw rationalizations with functors $Q_{E,W}$ ($W=X,Y$) [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Set
$$H_E^{\rm int}=Lf_{\mathcal O_E}^*(-)(d)[2d],\qquad G_E^{\rm int}=Rf_{\mathcal O_E}^!,$$
using [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Suppose a simultaneous integral natural isomorphism $\eta_E:H_E^{\rm int}\Rightarrow G_E^{\rm int}$ and its exact integral coefficient comparisons $a^{\rm int},b^{\rm int}$ are given with all the equations of [lem-pur-adic-purity-scalar-naturality]. In particular $b^{\rm int}$ is the adjoint transpose of scalar extension of the exceptional counit following the inverse compact-support comparison, and the scalar functor in those equations is ordinary tensor
$$C_{F/E,W}(-)=(-)\otimes^L_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,W}.$$

On these inputs the natural completion map $\chi:C_{F/E,W}\xrightarrow{\sim}(-)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_F$ identifies this functor with strict inverse-limit scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Under this identification the rational scalar functor $T_{F/E,W}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] is $Q_{F,W}C_{F/E,W}$ on integral representatives, with its tensor associator and shift comparisons retained.

The localized $H_E^{\rm int},G_E^{\rm int}$ are naturally identified with the specified functors
$$H_E=Lf_E^*(-)(d)[2d],\qquad G_E=Rf_E^!$$
on the rational categories, including their map actions and shift comparisons. Localization of $a^{\rm int},b^{\rm int}$ gives exact natural isomorphisms
$$a_{F/E}:T_{F/E,X}H_E\xrightarrow{\sim}H_FT_{F/E,Y},\qquad b_{F/E}:T_{F/E,X}G_E\xrightarrow{\sim}G_FT_{F/E,Y}.$$
Here $a$ is the specified pullback, tensor, twist and shift comparison, and $b$ is the counit-preserving exceptional mate for the coefficient-passage functor of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], rather than a comparison chosen using a duality identification. They obey the unit, associator and shift equations of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Writing $\eta_{E,Q_EK_0}=Q_E(\eta_{E,K_0})$ for the localized transformation, their equations are
$$b_{F/E,K}\circ T_{F/E,X}(\eta_{E,K})=\eta_{F,T_{F/E,Y}K}\circ a_{F/E,K},$$
$$T_{F/E,X}(\eta_{E,K}^{-1})\circ b_{F/E,K}^{-1}=a_{F/E,K}^{-1}\circ\eta_{F,T_{F/E,Y}K}^{-1}.$$
These are equations of natural transformations on all rational morphisms; both respect identity coefficient extensions, successive coefficient extensions and shifts.

proof.text: Obtain normalized source localization with its exactness and shift structure, and obtain scalar localization with its component, shift, exactness, unit and associator normalization.
Descend gamma and a through those normalized identifications. This supplies eta, the canonical a, and the two localized comparison equations, retaining all shift compatibilities.

Apply forward purity and source coherence descent. Taking inverses of the forward equality of composed component isomorphisms gives the inverse square. Apply the final exceptional equations in the same coordinates for localization shift, counit transpose, unit and composition. Package these witnesses and equations into Result.

No duality-chosen comparison and no new nodes.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-O3-1a3942927 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all nine steps in full, against the full statement of every cited node and the main-20261015 proof of thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity, Steps 1-2. This is the first delivery of this new node; live and side-live hold it unsplit and there is no repair note for it, so it is not superseded. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged against live. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses. A traversal of the dependencies (about 16.6k nodes) never reaches the item or its parent. There is no SGA citation and every step is under 2000 characters. Step checks: (1) the finite-type-over-noetherian leaf and kun-dimension cover the scheme hypotheses, and ell is invertible since char k = p. (2) chi from finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison on complete inputs, the associator normalization a^I o I(chi) o chi = chi o a^C, the chain shift, and T = Q_F C from prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension; for E=F the step keeps the completeness map and unitor before using T_{E/E}=id. (3) rational-transport gives the E-linear extension and the definitions give the map action u(x)lambda. (4) the integral Hom bijection of prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint (separated X,Y) is O_E-linear, so tensoring with E gives the rational Homs; the counit is Q(eps). (5) localizing a, with twist coherence. (6) I checked the type of eps_F o P_F(b~) = T_Y(eps_E) o c^{-1} (P_F T_X G_E K -> T_Y K); it is the transpose form of def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate, and injectivity gives b~ = b. Steps 7-9 are genuinely elementary: multiply by lambda and add, invert, and apply Q to the unit, associator and shift equations. Edge cases checked: E=F, ramified E in F, a chain E in F in L, d=0, empty schemes, K=0. FIX (E5): Step 6 only asserted that b is also the coefficient-passage comparison of def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image. The repair names that comparison beta, quotes its counit equation from lem-coef-rational-operations ('preserve ... counits, including under finite scalar extension'), and gets beta = b by the same injectivity. Only the text of Step 6 changes. The 12 declared tool_uses are generic scalar, adjunction and coherence calculus and are accepted. Maintainer note: prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint's G_f and def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image's Rf^!_{O_E} share the object formula but name different coherent realizations; this is inherited and does not block this delivery.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
